meta.description: Store, share and work on your documents and spreadsheets in the cloud.

landing.headline: Your files, documents and spreadsheets in one place
landing.subheadline: Upload, organise and share your files securely, from any device. Made in Portugal, hosted in the EU.

features.driveText: Upload files, organise them in folders, find anything quickly and access it from any device.
features.shareText: Share with specific people as viewer, commenter or editor, or with anyone who has the link.
features.editorsText: Create and edit documents and spreadsheets together, compatible with Word, Excel and Google files.
